PrivateType is a private, local push-to-talk dictation app for Windows. Hold a shortcut, speak, and release it to insert text into the field where dictation began, without cloud recognition or transcript history.

## Improvements in this release

### More reliable microphones

- PrivateType now remembers your microphone by its Windows device identity instead of its position in the device list. Plugging in or removing another device no longer switches dictation to the wrong microphone.
- Full microphone names are shown in Settings instead of names cut off at 31 characters.
- Your existing microphone choice is carried over automatically when its name identifies exactly one device. Otherwise the system default is used and PrivateType tells you, so you can choose again in **Settings**.

### Dictation that cannot get stuck

- If Windows never reports that the shortcut was released (for example while an administrator window is in front), PrivateType now notices the key is up and finishes the dictation instead of recording indefinitely.

### Fewer startup conflicts

- The local speech engine now picks a free local port each time it starts, so another program using the previous fixed port no longer stops the model from loading.
- The model now also unloads after the selected idle time when you never dictate after starting PrivateType.

### Settings and messages

- An invalid value in the settings file now resets only that setting, and PrivateType names which settings were reset. Previously every setting returned to its default.
- "Text not inserted" messages now explain why, and the remaining Polish-only error messages are now in English.

### Under the hood

- Updated to .NET 10, the current long-term-support release. .NET 8 support ends on 10 November 2026.

## Download and start

1. Download `PrivateType-1.0.8-win-x64.zip` and `PrivateType-1.0.8-win-x64.zip.sha256` below.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Extract the complete ZIP into a writable folder.
4. Open `PrivateType 1.0.8` and double-click `PrivateType.exe`.
5. Approve the separate local speech-model download on first launch if the verified model is not already in the shared cache.

The model is not bundled in the ZIP. PrivateType downloads it directly from NVIDIA on Hugging Face and verifies its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before use.

## Requirements

- 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11
- A modern x64 CPU and at least 4 GB RAM; 8 GB or more is recommended
- About 2 GB free disk space for the portable app, model, and working room
- [Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015–2022 (x64)](https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe)

## Privacy

Speech recognition runs locally. PrivateType has no account, cloud-recognition fallback, telemetry, retained audio, or transcript history. Review diagnostic reports before sharing them because application diagnostics can still contain information about your computer environment.
